description.value:
Your soul is interwoven with the cold of the void. The Shaper of Ecstasy took your name in exchange.

Bound by Cold (the gift). You gain permanent resistance 10 to cold.

Mantle of the Frozen Heart 2 (the gift). Once per day, you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CcXtbTxtdV9MKQfu]{Mantle of the Frozen Heart} as an innate spell — for 1 minute your skin and armor turn to the void's blue ice. Choose two of its four aspects; the frost-resistance is already yours, so spend the gift on claws, retaliation, or the glide of ice.

The Name Given to the Dark (the cost). The world forgets you: you take a permanent −2 status penalty to Diplomacy. Those who were closest to you have the feeling they know you from somewhere. You may take a new name.

The Cold Does Not Bite Its Own (the finale). You and your party ignore the Queen of Shadows' bone-chilling rime.
